page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.u2a-c1m2.16xlarge is an x86_64 virtualization instance provisioned on KVM hypervisors. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs powered by AMD EPYC processors operating at a base clock speed of 2.25 GHz. Paired with 128.0 GB of system memory, the instance maintains a 1:2 vCPU-to-memory allocation yielding 2.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

The hardware configuration includes no integrated local storage and features zero GPUs, requiring persistent block storage to be provisioned via attached network disks. Network connectivity is rated at a baseline bandwidth of 16 Gbps. The instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses, which must be routed or assigned separately.

With its 1:2 compute-to-memory ratio, the ecs.u2a-c1m2.16xlarge provides high core density suitable for compute-bound operations that do not demand extensive in-memory footprints. Typical workloads include multi-threaded batch processing, distributed build systems, media encoding, and clustered worker nodes.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.u2a-c1m2.16xlarge is a dedicated compute-oriented virtual server running on the KVM hypervisor. Powered by AMD EPYC processors built on the x86_64 architecture, it delivers 64 dedicated vCPUs operating at a frequency of 2.25 GHz. The system is equipped with 128.0 GB of RAM, establishing a 1:2 core-to-memory distribution of 2.0 GB per vCPU. The server has no bundled local storage disks and no graphics processing units, relying entirely on network-attached storage options. Network interfaces feature a baseline throughput of 16 Gbps, and no complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned by default. This configuration provides high parallelism for workloads focused on integer operations and multi-threaded computation, such as distributed compilation, CI/CD pipeline workers, batch computation jobs, and front-end web server fleets.
